vi.title: Ask Vi
vi.demoNote: Demo: Vi gives sample answers from the job data. The live app answers anything about the job.
vi.emptyJob: Ask about this job: the scope, what's left, photos for pay, how to do a step. Vi answers from the job record and the trade checklist.
vi.emptyGeneral: Ask a general question, or pick a job above so Vi can answer from its record.
vi.fine: Vi can be wrong. For safety, money or anything structural, call your PM.
vi.offline: Vi needs a connection. Ask again when you have signal.
vi.limit: That's today's limit for Vi. Call your PM, or ask again tomorrow.
vi.notYourJob: Vi can only answer about your own jobs.

admin.whoToCall.sf: This step is Salesforce. Contact Matt.
admin.whoToCall.aws: This step is AWS. Contact Donald.
admin.langHint: People who asked for Vista in another language. Vi already answers them in it.

admin.call.invoice: Payable invoice linking and the ACH run
admin.call.sf: Salesforce records, statuses, the Vista flows
admin.call.aws: Vista down, texts not sending, sign-in codes not arriving
admin.call.crew: A crew can't sign in or doesn't see a job
